title: 将句子排序
summary: 乱序句子的每个单词末尾带一位位置数字，恢复正确单词顺序并删除数字。
insight: 拆分单词后按末尾数字放入对应下标，存入时去掉最后一个字符，最后连接。

solutions.title: 后缀位置放置
solutions.idea: 直接利用编码位置恢复顺序，无需比较排序。
steps: 对 word：position=lastDigit-1，result[position]=去掉末字符，join 返回

code.java: class Solution { public String sortSentence(String sentence){String[] words=sentence.split(" "),result=new String[words.length];for(String word:words)result[word.charAt(word.length()-1)-'1']=word.substring(0,word.length()-1);return String.join(" ",result);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun sortSentence(sentence:String):String{val words=sentence.split(' ');val result=Array(words.size){""};for(word in words)result[word.last()-'1']=word.dropLast(1);return result.joinToString(" ")} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: string sortSentence(string sentence){stringstream stream(sentence);vector<string> result(9);string word;int count=0;while(stream>>word){result[word.back()-'1']=word.substr(0,word.size()-1);++count;}string answer;for(int i=0;i<count;++i){if(i)answer+=' ';answer+=result[i];}return answer;} };
